rule: After two failed attempts of the same mechanism, stop implementation and perform architecture review. Release-native drawing work follows D1-D9. V10 and V12 are explicitly non-release lanes. D2 authorization is claim-scoped; a global process-route OPEN may not blanket-block unrelated controlled claims. A rejected method cannot be retried by renaming/repackaging.
